tool_call_format: xml: <tool_call><function=NAME><parameter=KEY>value</parameter></function></tool_call>, preceded by a <tools> block of JSON tool definitions inside the system turn
known_template_errors: developer role: Jinja Exception: Unexpected message role. (raw template; llama-server maps developer to system before rendering)
tool_calls whose function.arguments is a JSON string: TypeError while iterating arguments|items (llama-server sends object arguments because caps reports supports_object_arguments)
messages with no user turn: Jinja Exception: No user query found in messages.
system message not first: Jinja Exception: System message must be at the beginning.
system content containing an image item: Jinja Exception: System message cannot contain images.
notes: Qwen3.5-style ChatML template. reasoning_effort is never referenced: all six effort values plus a nested reasoning.effort render byte-identical to no effort at all, so they are silently ignored, not rejected (supports_reasoning_effort=false in llama-server caps). enable_thinking is the only thinking switch: false renders an empty  thinking\n\n</think> block in the generation prompt; the alternative variable name thinking is ignored. Tools are described as JSON in <tools> and called as XML, and tool responses are folded into a user turn wrapped in <tool_response>. The template is vision-aware (user image items become <|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>) but rejects images in the system turn. It also requires at least one real user query.
